description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the sample token count and the number of shared experts for two samples across six different categories: Intent, Summary, Law, Translation, Code, and Math. The x-axis is labeled "Sample Token Count" and uses a base-2 logarithmic scale, with tick marks at intervals of powers of 2 ranging from $2^9$ to $2^{20}$. The y-axis is labeled "Shared Experts for Two Samples" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 6.0, with tick marks every 0.5 units. All categories are represented by solid lines without markers. The "Intent" line (coral) begins at approximately 3.9 before $2^9$, rises to 4.5 at $2^9$, dips to 4.2 at $2^{10}$, increases sharply to 5.5 at $2^{11}$, and then climbs steadily to reach a maximum of 6.0 at $2^{16}$, where it remains through $2^{20}$. The "Summary" line (blue) starts at 2.0 at $2^9$, experiences a sharp increase to 5.0 at $2^{10}$, remains relatively flat until $2^{11}$, and then rises to reach 6.0 at $2^{16}$, staying constant thereafter. The "Law" line (gold) starts at approximately 3.6 before $2^9$, peaks early at 5.4 at $2^{10}$, drops to 5.1 at $2^{11}$, rises to 5.8 at $2^{12}$, dips slightly to 5.7 at $2^{13}$, and reaches 6.0 by $2^{16}$, remaining flat until $2^{20}$. The "Translation" line (purple) begins at 5.1 before $2^9$, rises to 5.5 at $2^9$, decreases to 5.0 at $2^{10}$, increases to 5.7 at $2^{11}$, remains steady to $2^{12}$, and reaches 6.0 at $2^{15}$, staying constant through $2^{20}$. The "Code" line (grey) starts at 2.0 at $2^9$, rises slowly to 2.1 at $2^{10}$, increases to 3.2 at $2^{11}$ and 3.6 at $2^{12}$, peaks locally at 4.4 at $2^{13}$, declines to 3.9 at $2^{14}$, and then rises sharply to reach 6.0 at $2^{18}$, remaining flat until $2^{20}$. The "Math" line (green) starts at approximately 3.8 before $2^9$, exhibits a steady upward trend to 5.0 at $2^{10}$, 5.3 at $2^{11}$, and 5.6 at $2^{12}$, eventually reaching 6.0 at $2^{16}$ and remaining constant through $2^{20}$.
